programs.programName: DC Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)

verified.notes: DC LIHEAP uses a 60% State Median Income test in FY26; no separate age or asset test was found in the official sources reviewed. Monthly income limits were derived from the official FY26 annual figures (1 person $60,869; 2 people $80,869) by dividing by 12 and rounding to the nearest integer.
